target: same z affects function 1 and function 2
minimum_design: manipulate or measure one invariant z coordinate under both functions
positive_result: non-zero z response for both declared functions
main_alternative: different hidden coordinates or correlated traits drive the two functions

minimum_design: multi-level z with function-specific response curves
positive_result: z1_star and z2_star are separated with uncertainty incompatible with one common optimum
main_alternative: one common optimum or unresolved curvature
claim_ceiling: functional conflict on one shared coordinate

target: combined optimum is displaced from function-specific optima
minimum_design: multi-level z under both functions plus common fitness
positive_result: zc_star differs from at least one function-specific optimum and lies on the combined fitness maximum
main_alternative: intermediate phenotype caused by unmeasured process or monotonic endpoint

target: functional weights causally maintain the compromise
minimum_design: selectively weaken function 1 and function 2 in separate treatments
positive_result: weakening function 2 shifts zc_star toward z1_star and weakening function 1 shifts zc_star toward z2_star
main_alternative: trait optimum fixed by non-focal costs or intervention contamination

target: opposing functions act on the same local z contrast
minimum_design: two-level z x function-1 access x function-2 access crossed design
positive_result: function-1 access makes the z effect more positive while function-2 access makes it less positive
main_alternative: only one function responds or interventions are not selective

minimum_design: heritability plus repeated selection or experimental evolution
positive_result: trait means/frequencies move predictably when functional weights are changed
main_alternative: phenotypic plasticity only or no response to selection

target: larger one-axis conflict creates greater potential value of added dimensionality
minimum_design: estimate z1_star z2_star local curvature/weights and architecture cost
positive_result: estimated compromise penalty increases with optimum separation and joint functional strength
main_alternative: added architecture cost dominates or residual coupling prevents release
